profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Encouraging women in STEM education and careers is one of my true passions.  I am surrounded by brilliant women in my own life, the first of whom is my mother.  I've worked with other women to continue groups and initiatives to support women in STEM, and I love to encourage young women to do the same.  With Honda R&D, I was supported by our Women in Engineering Network to lead a STEM to Bloom day with Benjamin Logan Elementary to teach some engineering skills to students.  Of the 3 years I lead the program, it was not only a fun experience, but rewarding as well.

Like many other women (and some men, too), I have gaps in my life when I decided to set aside my career and focus on raising my family.  This time, coming back into the working world, I wanted to have a new skill and fresh mind, and try a field that fit my strengths.  I am responsible and take ownership of my projects.  I want everyone on my team to feel included and important.  I will find the solution to the challenges set in front of me.

I love to pursue projects that continue to grow my own knowledge, and I want to work with people who support me and others in a positive environment.  If this sounds like a fit, I'd love to talk to you.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created and maintained documents and communications microservices for Property and Casualty Claims users in Java.
Updated and maintained documents and communications APIs.
Created Angular feature for managers to text agents when overtime work was available.
Created frontend Out of Office feature for agent emails using Gosu.
Regularly worked on debugging defects when they were discovered.

positions.title: Java Student
positions.description:
Attended Tech Elevator as a Java bootcamp student.
Final capstone project tech stack included Java and Vue.js (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).  Called "Foxtrot Fitness", allowed users to sign up for fitness events like "Run the circumference of the Earth!", where more than one participant could help complete the event.  Allowed users to choose between running, biking, and swimming.  Users Dashboard would show all the events the user was currently participating in, and would allow the user to track their progress.  Users could also create custom events.

positions.title: Materials Engineer
positions.description:
Oversaw all new interior paint development projects for HRA Automotive and Power Sports production models.
Researched innovative coating technologies.
Started and led the STEM to Bloom Women's Engineering event promoting girls in STEM.

positions.title: Coordinator-Revenue Recovery
positions.description:
Review customer natural gas accounts to determine payment plan eligibility.
Calculate payment plan customer required default payments.
Determine security deposit refunds or transfers on non-activated accounts.

positions.title: MBA Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
Analyzed and compiled responses from Volunteerism Survey for the Jefferson Award.
Organized the attendance at the four week Advanced Leadership Academy, sent emails weekly and tracked students attendance.

positions.title: Chemical Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
Analyzed data received from a batch reactor process, wrote a summary and reviewed with the lead engineer.
Developed graphics for CAD computer program for specific control operations process. 
Set up SharePoint for the AC Group and designed the look for the department.

positions.title: Research and Development Chemical Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
Conducted experiments on a new potential product to better understand its properties.
Analyzed lab results and determined next steps.
Organized and entered customer contact information for database.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: Assisted students with math coursework during open study hours, directed students to the appropriate tutor according the mathematical learning they needed.

positions.title: Environmental, Health and Safety Co-Op
positions.description:
Created a template for organizing all water permit summaries for ease of access and ability to expand with additional permit data.
Organized the data about the particulars of the pipeline coatings for reference by engineers involved in working with the pipelines. 
Updated Weekly Scoreboard for the department tracking and reporting any incident injuries along with writing articles on current and new safety topics.

positions.title: Optometric Technician
positions.description:
Prescreened patients prior examination by doctor, accommodated patient's needs and responded to their requests.
Handled incoming calls, maintained patients' records and scheduled appointments.
